maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost isolated row contains 5 distinct dark clusters on the left side of the muzzle, situated approximately 10-15 pixels above the dense primary row, following a slightly convex path relative to the nasal midline.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 90-95% dark melanin saturation, with sparse, localized pinkish/pale pixel clusters primarily located along the superior dorsal ridge and the interior margins of the nostrils.

other_distinctive_markers: Open-mouth posture revealing lower incisors and lower canines; distinct dark pigmentation of the lower labial margin; prominent vertical philtrum.
